title: BiteCheck AnalyzeRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/analyze. The web app sends url only; the extension also sends extracted DOM data.

source.description: Drives which enrichment path runs. 'web' has no DOM data and falls back to slug + catalog + Open Food Facts.

url.description: Full amazon.in product URL. The ASIN and the product slug are parsed out of it server-side.

extracted.description: Extension only. Read from the page DOM in the user's own browser session - never scraped server-side.

brand.description: #bylineInfo, with the 'Brand: ' / 'Visit the ... Store' wrapper stripped

technicalDetails.description: Flattened key/value pairs from the Product/Technical Details tables. Keys are used verbatim, e.g. 'FSSAI License', 'Net Quantity'.

nutritionTable.description: Raw label rows. Values stay as displayed strings; parsing and unit normalization happen server-side in core/nutrition.py.

forceRefresh.description: Bypass the DynamoDB cache and re-run RAG. Used during development and by the demo reset.
